title: Te Hiahia i roto i te Rūma Tapu
intro: Ka tomo koe ki te wāhi tapu marino, ka kite koe i tētahi pononga pono a Allah e tū ana i roto i te inoi. Kua ara ake ō rātou ringa, kua ara ake ō rātou kanohi, ā, kei roto i ō rātou ngākau te hiahia nui kua roa e ora ana. Ko wai tēnei wairua manawanui kāore nei i ngohe tōna whakawhirinaki ki a Allah?
clues: He maha ngā tau i noho ai ahau i roto i te karakia me te inoi, me te kite i ngā merekara i whakakaha i tōku whakapono.
I tukua mai ki ahau te kawenga ki te tiaki i tētahi wairua taitamariki manaakitanga i roto i te wāhi tapu.
I ahau e koroheke haere ana, ko tōku pouri nui ko te korenga o āku tamariki, he pakoko hoki taku wahine, ā, kua maha haere māua.
I inoi ahau ki tōku Ariki mō tētahi uri mōku ake whānau, hei tangata hei kawe i te taonga tuku iho o te poropititanga.
I ahau e tū ana i te wāhi inoi, ka karanga mai ngā anahera ki ahau, ka mea, 'Ka tukuna atu e Allah he rongo pai ki a koe', ā, ka pā mai te wehi me te mataku ki ahau.
I kīia mai ki ahau ka whānau he tama māku, ko Yahya tōna ingoa, he ingoa kāore anō kia hoatu ki tētahi i mua, ā, hei tohu kāore au e kōrero ki te tangata mō ngā rā e toru.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
